answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A iMEI registration with carrier device record works as the gate: a handset IMEI on the carrier's record since purchase. Each of 90 aliases needs its own device records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the reef signal is public, the sonnet check is automatic, and 90 aliases cost 90 times what one real agent costs, with the kernel trail open to all.
